description_en: Queries the mappings between resources (Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances) and labels
description_zh: 查询资源（DDoS高防实例）和标签的对应关系
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource. Valid values: INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The token that specifies the start point of the next query. Leave this parameter empty if no next query exists
parameters.help_zh: 指定下一个查询开始的Token。如果没有下一个查询，请留空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query for labels. Valid values of n: [1, 50], which specifies that you can query up to 50 instances at a time. Example: ResourceId.1, ResourceId.2, ..., ResourceId.50.
You must specify either ResourceId or the combination of Tag.Key and Tag.Value
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的DDoS高防实例ID，查询实例的标签。n的取值范围为 [1, 50]，用于指定多个实例，最多50个。例如：ResourceId.1，ResourceId.2，...，ResourceId.50。
您必须指定ResourceId或者Tag.Key和Tag.Value组合
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key to query for instances. Valid values of n: [1, 20], which specifies that you can query up to 20 tag keys at a time. Example: Tag.1.Key, Tag.2.Key, ..., Tag.20.Key.
You must specify either ResourceId or the combination of Tag.Key and Tag.Value
fields.help_zh:
指定要查询的标签键，查询标签下的实例。n的取值范围为 [1, 20]，用于指定多个标签键，最多20个。例如：Tag.1.Key，Tag.2.Key，...，Tag.20.Key。
您必须指定ResourceId或者Tag.Key和Tag.Value组合
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value to query for instances. Valid values of n: [1, 20], which specifies that you can query up to 20 tag values at a time. Example: Tag.1.Value, Tag.2.Value, ..., Tag.20.Value.
You must specify either ResourceId or the combination of Tag.Key and Tag.Value. When you specify a tag value, you must also specify the corresponding tag key. After you specify a tag key, the tag value can be left empty
fields.help_zh:
指定要查询的标签值，查询标签下的实例。n的取值范围为 [1, 20]，用于指定多个标签值，最多20个。例如：Tag.1.Value，Tag.2.Value，...，Tag.20.Value。
您必须指定ResourceId或者Tag.Key和Tag.Value组合。指定标签值时，必须指定标签键；指定标签键后，标签值可以留空
fields.name: value

NextToken.description_en: The token that specifies the start point of the next query. This parameter is empty if no next query exists
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token。没有下一个查询时为空
